LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestRadiusToolTip: How far from the colonist to look for something to haul when a harvest finishes.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestIncludeTreesToolTip: Also haul after cutting plants and chopping trees, not only after harvesting.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestRequireHaulingToolTip: Colonists with the Hauling work type turned off go straight back to their other work.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestCropOnlyToolTip: Only haul what was just harvested. When off, the crop is hauled first, and anything else nearby if no crop is in range.
